display_long_description:
Welcome to a whole new kind of tag experience — where you’re not just another player… you’re a Sack.

Jump into a fun social world built for hanging out, exploring, and fast-paced tag gameplay. Whether you’re chilling with friends or chasing them down in intense fire tag rounds, there’s always something happening.

Play as a customizable Sack character and express your style with cosmetics you can unlock and buy. Join friends instantly using room codes and jump straight into the action.

The main gameplay is fire tag. Once you’re on fire, your goal is to chase down other players and tag them to pass the fire along. It’s fast, chaotic, and keeps every round exciting.

It’s not just about competition — you can also hang out, explore, and mess around with other players in social spaces built for fun.

Features:
• Play as unique Sack characters
• Join friends with room codes
• Buy and unlock cosmetics
• Fast-paced fire tag gameplay
• Social hangout spaces
• Fun movement and exploration

Whether you want to compete, customize your look, or just chill with friends, Sack Games gives you the freedom to play your way.
